changelog:
- Video Playback Lag Eliminated: Removed CPU-heavy JavaScript polling loops during video playback and replaced with Blink/GPU static CSS ad hiding for 60fps buttery-smooth playback.
- Instagram Ad & Banner Blocking: Enabled cosmetic ad-blocking on Instagram web, instantly hiding sponsored feed posts and home app download banners.
- Clean YouTube Native Ad Skipper: Auto-clicks native YouTube skip buttons and triggers official player skipAd API cleanly with zero video stream tampering or speed hacks.
- Universal Anti-Adblock Defusers & Scroll Restorer: Defuses modals and strips scroll locks across news portals (Fox News, The Sun, The Guardian, Forbes).
- High-Contrast Dark Mode: Fixes dark gray on black text on BBC Sport and Onmanorama with crisp high-contrast typography while protecting media.
- Media Player 6-10s Buffering Fix: Standard Google IMA SDK stub eliminates ad loading timeouts on JWPlayer, Brightcove, Video.js, and Dailymotion.
- NextDNS Live Multi-Layer Blocking: Added NextDNS DoH provider and Private DNS integration with live cross-site query filtering.
